{%- if versions -%} {#- ============================================================ 1. Normalize each entry to {name, url}. sphinx-multiversion may pass Version objects (.name/.url) or (name, url) tuples. ============================================================ -#} {%- set items = [] -%} {%- for v in versions -%} {%- if v.name is defined -%} {%- set _ = items.append({'name': v.name, 'url': v.url}) -%} {%- else -%} {%- set _ = items.append({'name': v[0], 'url': v[1]}) -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {#- ============================================================ 2. Build a semver sort key with built-in filters only (no regex, so conf.py needs no extra setup): strip leading "v", keep digits/dots until a non-digit, zero-pad each number to 6 chars. v1.10.0 -> "000001.000010.000000" v1.9.0 -> "000001.000009.000000" (so v1.10.0 > v1.9.0) ============================================================ -#} {%- set keyed = [] -%} {%- for v in items -%} {%- set raw = v.name -%} {%- if raw[0] in ['v', 'V'] -%}{%- set raw = raw[1:] -%}{%- endif -%} {%- set ns = namespace(s='', stop=false) -%} {%- for ch in raw -%} {%- if not ns.stop -%} {%- if ch in '0123456789.' -%} {%- set ns.s = ns.s ~ ch -%} {%- else -%} {%- set ns.stop = true -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- set pad = [] -%} {%- for p in ns.s.split('.') -%} {%- if p and p.isdigit() -%} {%- set _ = pad.append('%06d' % (p | int)) -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- set _ = keyed.append({'name': v.name, 'url': v.url, 'key': pad | join('.')}) -%} {%- endfor -%} {#- ============================================================ 3. Sort descending: first item is the latest version. Capture the latest version's NAME so the top button can tell whether the page you're viewing is the newest one. ============================================================ -#} {%- set ordered = keyed | sort(attribute='key', reverse=true) -%} {%- set latest_name = ordered[0].name if ordered else '' -%} {#- Name of the version currently being viewed. -#} {%- if current_version.name is defined -%} {%- set current_name = current_version.name -%} {%- else -%} {%- set current_name = current_version | string -%} {%- endif -%}
    {%- for v in ordered -%}
  • {{ v.name }} {%- if loop.first %} ({{ _("latest") }}){%- endif -%}
    • {%- endfor -%}
{%- endif -%}
